summary: SendGrid's Email API is a documented REST v3 Web API authenticated with permission-scoped API keys sent as Bearer tokens. summary: Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source document broad REST and GraphQL APIs, deployment-specific authentication, and local development MCP tools. PaaS/Open Source integrations can be merchant-created, while Adobe Commerce as a Cloud Service requires an IMS-enabled license and administrative setup; Composio has no exact entry.

next_action: Identify the deployment model first. For PaaS/Open Source, create an Admin integration with least-privilege API resources; for SaaS, use Adobe Developer Console and IMS OAuth 2 credentials with the commerce.accs scope. Install the development MCP tools separately if useful.

summary: Asana documents a REST platform, personal access tokens, OAuth 2.0, Enterprise-only service accounts, and a remote V2 MCP server. Developers can test against an existing workspace or a free account.

summary: Grain provides a broad REST API for recordings, transcripts, uploads, clips, stories, playlists, hooks, and workspace metadata, plus an official remote MCP server. Personal API access is available on Free, while workspace-wide access is paid and admin-gated.
blocker: Workspace Access Tokens require Business or Enterprise and admin generation; workspace-scope OAuth clients must be verified by Grain. The MCP server accepts personal-scope tokens only, and some MCP tools require Business or Enterprise. The current API version is 2026-10-01, not the deprecated 2025-10-31.
next_action: For a personal integration, generate a PAT on Free or use personal-scope OAuth and send Public-Api-Version: 2026-10-01. For workspace-wide access, use a Business or Enterprise admin to generate a WAT, but keep MCP on a separate personal-scope token.
